title: History
description: Every action is one History entry: undo steps back, redo steps forward, and clicking an entry jumps straight to it.

bubble.title: History: every action, listed
bubble.body: Every action you take is one entry in the History list in this section. Undo steps back through the list, redo steps forward — and the list itself is clickable.

bubble.title: Make an entry
bubble.body: Steer to a corner and press I to start a rectangle.

bubble.title: Watch the list
bubble.body: Steer to the opposite corner and press I again. A new entry appears at the bottom of the History list — one entry per action.

bubble.title: Undo it
bubble.body: Choose Edit ▸ Undo. The rectangle disappears, and the History position steps back one entry.

bubble.title: Redo it
bubble.body: Choose Edit ▸ Redo. The rectangle returns, and the position steps forward again.

bubble.title: Click to jump
bubble.body: Click any entry in this History list to jump straight to that point: the document becomes what it was then. Click the newest entry to return to the present. Jumping is not undoing — no entries are lost.

bubble.title: Nothing is lost
bubble.body: Undo is one step per action (Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z, day to day), and the list makes every step reachable by name. Work boldly — you can always step back.
